name: crissy-west
summary:
I wrote plan.md for a row of ten low historic Army buildings in white and cream with green trim, using grey and red roofs. The roofs are only planned, not dry-run with the roof tool. Each irregular footprint is a gabled or hipped main block plus low lean-tos on the leftover cells; on the angled plots the ridges step south-east along the diagonal.
It reads as the Presidio through the stepped grey warehouse with green sliding doors and a GYM sign, the cream Mission building (red hip roof, arched arcade), the white porch house and the 1915 Coast Guard station with its glass cupola and US flag. Ten Presidio buildings, each on its footprint in site orientation: white/cream walls on a plinth, red or grey roofs with lean-tos, green trim and shutters, a flagpole and cupola on the Coast Guard station, with lawns and lamps.
Elements checklist and palette are in elements.md and plan.md. Interiors are hollow, lit volumes (exterior-only kit).
Six parts: two shell parts, two roof parts, facade fittings, grounds and light. (7 of 7 parts finished)
